source_comparison.limitations: Compares evaluated source count and axis-converted bounds. Does not establish material equivalence, scientific accuracy or visual quality.

measured_parameter_interpretations.leaf_length_range_m: Hard final meter range, measured above; tolerance only 1e-6m float precision.
measured_parameter_interpretations.leaf_width_to_length: Actual side vertex separation divided by actual base-tip length.
measured_parameter_interpretations.leaf_thickness_m: Actual peak-to-peak local normal separation; preserves 0.009m.
measured_parameter_interpretations.trunk_base_diameter_m: Original construction section before basal flare x1.33 and skeleton normalization. Actual basal ring maximum chord is measured.
measured_parameter_interpretations.trunk_top_height_m: Original centerline input before skeleton normalization; not total tree height.
measured_parameter_interpretations.root_radius_m: Original radial envelope input times per-root .84+.14*sin(j*2.2), then skeleton normalization; actual tips are measured.

r001_difference.note: Only blade dimensions and the analytically necessary common skeleton scale change. No topology, component counts, palette or orientation design change.
